headline: DeepSeek makes its DeepInfer inference framework fully open source
body: DeepSeek has made its in-house inference framework, DeepInfer, fully open source. DeepSeek says this will help make AI more affordable, and that DeepInfer powers its DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model at scale, with high throughput and low latency.
note: For banks and payment firms that run models on their own infrastructure, the cost of inference is a budget line. DeepSeek is sharing its production stack with the community.

evidence.text: DeepSeek has made its in-house inference framework, DeepInfer , fully open source, saying this will help make artificial intelligence more affordable.
DeepInfer powers the company’s DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model at scale with high throughput and low latency, DeepSeek said in a Tuesday (Oct. 20) post on X.
“We’re sharing our production stack to help the community lower compute costs, reduce energy use and make AI more affordable,” DeepSeek said in the post.
